response.speaker: Ann
response.text: I believe I've recalled certain... some very vague feelings. I am not sure they can even be called memories...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Though I don't know whether humans keep their memories in their heads or in their heart...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: But Oceanids seem to have neither a brain nor heart, just water...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: If only I could be like that silly dog, just sit there and mumble stuff like "Drive Defragmenting" to recall everything...

choices.text: I want to know more about you, Ann...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: I don't know what else I can tell you...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: I'm the part of Mary-Ann that was imagined into being here, but... but she rejected me, and the others as well... I mean, other existences...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: The Princess Lyris I want to rescue does not exist. "Mary-Ann" is also not Mary-Ann, and isn't that silly dog's owner.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: I don't know why, but when I see that silly dog, something just swells inside of me... It feels like bubbles! But they burst whenever I get close to remembering...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Caterpillar seems to know something, but he won't say much if he's not 100% sure.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: We came to the place with Narzissenkreuz in its name, yet nothing was resolved...

choices.text: I want to know more about Princess Lyris...

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Princess Lyris is kind and courageous. That's why she endangered herself... in order to protect her friends.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Before, all I thought was that I must have been a friend of hers and she protected me, so now that's she's in trouble, I have to save her.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: Even though she might not want me to do that... because she is too nice, and would rather suffer than let her friends be in danger.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: But if I don't save her, how could I be worthy of being her friend or deserve her protection?

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: "Memories"... They're hazy, like whirlpools in water. Emotions and desires, on the other hand, feel so real, despite me realizing she's just a character in a story now...

choices.text: It's all right. Just go to bed.

response.speaker: Ann
response.text: #Okay. Good night, Knight {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: #...Calculation process halted. What are your instructions, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: Through communication with Ann the Oceanid and the former Narzissenkreuz Ordo member Caterpillar, some promising information has been obtained.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: I am Prototype 4ACV07, designed by Guillotin to accompany and protect my master, Ms. Mary-Ann.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: Unfortunately, no additional information on Ms. Mary-Ann is currently available.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: Moreover, Ann the Oceanid was able to provide very little information.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: The remaining member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo Caterpillar did not provide complete information.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: More time is required for analysis...

choices.text: I want to know more about you, Seymour...

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: I am Prototype 4ACV07, designed by Guillotin to accompany and protect my master, Ms. Mary-Ann.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: I am equipped with the most advanced memory storage unit, logic unit, optics, and various functional modules from the Fontaine Institute of Natural Philosophy.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: This allows me to keep a log of Ms. Mary-Ann's daily life and also act as an agent's assistant.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: My present top priority is: To locate Ms. Mary-Ann and ensure her safety.

choices.text: I want to know more about Mary-Ann...

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: The purpose of my design and creation is to serve and protect my owner, Ms. Mary-Ann.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: My present top priority is: To locate Ms. Mary-Ann and ensure her safety.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: Ann the Oceanid exhibited certain behaviors identical to the past behaviors of Ms. Mary-Ann.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: But the factors comprising them... (loud mechanical noises)... (loud mechanical noises)...

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: Note: Regular record space collation can decrease the frequency of such issues effectively.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: #Affirmative. Have a nice day, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Anything else you want to talk about?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: It's nice that this place is so lively again after several centuries.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: ...Just joking. I think there's a purpose to all this... I mean, to us gathering like this. It's boring and foolish to treat it as simple, sheer coincidence.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Our encounter has to be an omen of a kind of beginning, akin to a repressed seed struggling before fully germinating.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: But on the other hand, before the actual apocalypse arrives, just who would try to find meaning in absurdity and be convinced that those signs herald that inevitable solemn moment?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Other than Narzissenkreuz, whom I used to call Master. Regardless, he deserved to be called a Grandmaster.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Just like our paths crossed here under the Doomsday Clock, if we follow along the woven path together, maybe we can...

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: ...I should save the rest of that thought for the end of the journey.

choices.text: I want to know more about you, Caterpillar...

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: What else is there to say about myself?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: I often feel mutually exclusive elements in the nature of my existence. Individually, they are pure, but also alien to each other.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Therefore, when they interact, they mix with the other and become impure. Can you understand that?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: My own identity is not consistent... Sometimes I am a Bloomguard, other times a dragon. My identity is a lie built out of the stories of others...

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: But I believe a definitive answer exists, a singular correct answer. As the hands on the clock move again, I'm ready to take that step.

choices.text: I want to know more about Lanoire...

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Our time together was very short, but I never thought I'd be so committed to playing the role of a protector for her.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: It was indeed a very novel experience. Perhaps I was attracted by her purity, because that's a quality I will never possess.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Yet the Fortress of Meropide is what kept her innocent... Somewhere she shouldn't have been in the first place.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: To give her an opportunity to choose, the right to choose must be first stripped from her.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: But whenever I think of how now, the mundane world has finally entered her heart...

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: I'll stay here until it's time for us to set out.
